title: Two wrong clue letters (276 drop pairs: one per block at 7+ checks, both in one block at 9+): key-rule battery with idea-104 hole fixes on 666,993 keyword alphabets, multiplier+adder words (71A) and word-turned rotor (72) on 22 of the 24 clue letters
k4_result: 0 passes in every test. Core (A-Z, KRYPTOS, theme and common-word alphabets, 19,622 alphabets x 5 layouts x Vig/Beau, all rules incl. the progressive hole form, bar 7 one-per-block / 9 one-block): 0 of 838.4 billion exact tests, chance 0.040. Wide (the other 647,371 alphabets of the 666,993 list, bar 8 / 9, no progressive hole form): 0 of 794.7 billion, chance 0.053 (at bar 7 chance would have been 1.30, so the bar was raised). Multiplier word + adder word: 0 of 101,556 systems. Rotor: 0 real wirings even at 5+ coincidences (248,495 words x 48 settings x 276 drops). Nothing to read.
controls: 3 shuffled K4s (seeds 1-3), same 276 drop pairs: core in full 0 / 0 / 0 (chance 0.040 each); wide on a different third each (215,790-215,791 alphabets) 0 / 0 / 0 (chance 0.018 each); pairs in full 0 / 0 / 0; rotor in full 0 / 0 / 0 at 5+. Same picture as K4.
planted: 11/11, each with two clue letters changed and both changed positions named exactly, the true letters restored by the rule: sliding key 7 (one per block; both in BERLINCLOCK), progressive key 5 (one per block; both in BERLINCLOCK), two stacked keys 4+7, progressive 6 moved on in A-Z order, cipher autokey lag 3 fed on A-Z, multiplier+adder (one per block; both in BERLINCLOCK), rotor (one per block; both in BERLINCLOCK). Keyword plants were searched on 3,000 random core alphabets plus the true one and read back 97/97 (autokey 94/97: the first 3 letters have no key).
scope_limits: Exactly two wrong clue letters (three or more not covered; one or none was idea 81 and earlier). Hidden-alphabet tests, hash joins, formula mining, keyed-lag autokey, evolving alphabets, mod 27-31, gap slack and word-break variants are not covered. The progressive hole form (key moved on along A-Z/KRYPTOS/M with 26 index offsets) ran on the 19,622 core alphabets only; the other 647,371 alphabets ran the rest of the battery at a raised bar of 8 checks for one-per-block pairs. Both-in-one-block pairs were judged only at 9+ checks, so rules with fewer checks there (long periods) are not covered for those pairs. Stacked keys p < q <= 26. With two letters dropped, the sliding and autokey tests lose the pairs through the dropped letters (no longer-range pairs are added), so they are a little weaker than on 24 letters. Rotor: attack 72's dictionary-word turning only. A wrong letter that no check of a rule touches (e.g. clue letters 21-23 and 63-65 for cipher autokey lag 3) cannot be found by any test and needs no correction.

negative.family: Two deliberately wrong clue letters (round 11 exact tests)
negative.hypothesis: Two of the 24 clue letters (one in each clue, or both in one) are wrong, which hid a keyword-alphabet key rule, a multiplier word + adder word, or a word-turned rotor from every exact test that needs 23 or 24 letters to fit.
negative.scope: all 276 pairs of dropped clue letters (143 one per block at 7+ checks, 133 in one block at 9+); kryptos.round11 battery + idea-104 holes (repeating <=17, sliding <=15, progressive <=12 incl. moved on in A-Z/KRYPTOS/M order with 26 offsets, autokey lag 1-6 fed on M/A-Z/KRYPTOS, chain taps <=6, two stacked keys p<q<=26 exact) on 19,622 core keyword alphabets at 7+, and without the progressive hole form on the other 647,371 of the 666,993 dictionary alphabets at 8+; 5 layouts x Vig/Beau; 71A p,q<=17 on A-Z/KRYPTOS; attack-72 rotor with 248,495 words; 1.64e12 exact tests
negative.outcome: Dead: K4 has 0 passes in every test with any two clue letters dropped (chance 0.040 core + 0.053 wide; controls: 3 shuffled K4s, 0 in every test; planted 11/11 with both changed positions named)
